prompt: Create ONE standalone weapon thumbnail concept for Stillness, a restrained low-poly pixel-graphic historical sword-fighting game. Square transparent RGBA image. Entire single sword fully visible, including pommel and tip, with 7 percent margin; pommel bottom-left, blade tip top-right, consistent 45 degree diagonal, near orthographic three-quarter object view. It should read clearly at 256px. Crisp faceted game-item artwork with broad deliberate polygonal shading and a limited subdued palette, polished edges but NOT a photographic render or flat cartoon. Soft upper-left light. No text labels, frames, scenery, hands, scabbards, pedestal, floating particles, extra weapons, lens flare. One straight rigid blade and a continuous aligned grip. This is a legendary Iberian-school TWO-HANDED greatsword adapted for the game, not a claimed reconstruction of a medieval literary sword. A real two-handed long grip, blade about 3.5 times the usable grip length; elegant functional proportions, not a giant anime slab. Item: DURANDAL, Roland's unbreakable relic sword, an ancient and solemn warrior saint's greatsword. Very long broad straight double-edged steel blade with a shallow central fuller in the lower half, gradual strong taper to a purposeful point. The blade should feel solid, clean and unbroken. Thick straight crossguard of old muted gold, squared geometric blunt quillon ends, a small restrained stepped relief pattern. Long deep oxblood-red leather grip, clearly large enough for two hands, broad worn wrapping bands and small dark antique-gold collars. A compact octagonal golden reliquary pommel, one tiny inset pale ivory window under a small cross-shaped protective grille, like an ancient portable reliquary, not a giant gem. Sparse old engraved cross markings near the guard, most blade plain bright cool steel. Color identity: cool steel, deep red, antique gold. The visual emphasis is the powerful wide blade and heavy cruciform silhouette, dignified and restrained, no rapier basket, no flame, no glowing aura, no elaborate vine ornament.
